The selected law branches have not yet been constructed or source-bound through finalization and saved processing.
law_text: The driver of a vehicle: Shall not back the vehicle unless such movement can be made with reasonable safety and without interfering with other traffic.

alternatives_and_boundaries: Backing movement with reasonable safety is an unresolved judgment requirement.
Traffic interference is a distinct requirement; compare same reverse maneuver with and without actual conflicting traffic, preserving pedestrian and geometry context.
No statutory numeric safety or interference threshold is supplied.

evidence_review.method: Exact statute, conditional witness and frozen accepted-evidence inventory read; no accepted recordings exist. Conditional witness does not establish physical safety or interference facts.

gaps.requirement: reasonable safety throughout backing and absence of traffic interference
